description: This file implements a SharedMemoryBuffer class for managing shared memory segments, including creation, mapping, unmapping, and data management for media playback buffers. It also includes factory methods and internal utility functions related to shared memory partitions and their sizes.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBuffer
classes.description: Manages a shared memory buffer for media data, including creation, mapping, unmapping, and data access functions.

methods.name: calculatePartitionSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of memory partitions based on media playback type and number of partitions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts MediaPlaybackType enum to string representation.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory for SharedMemoryBuffer instances.

methods.name: createSharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Creates a shared memory buffer with specified number of playbacks and web audio players.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes shared memory buffer, allocates memory, and sets up partitions.

methods.name: ~SharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Destructor that unmaps and closes the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: mapPartition
methods.description: Maps a partition for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: unmapPartition
methods.description: Unmaps a partition for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Clears data in a specified partition for a given media source type.

methods.name: getDataOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of data for a specific partition.

methods.name: getMaxDataLen
methods.description: Returns the maximum data length for a specific partition.

methods.name: getDataPtr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer for a specific partition.

methods.name: getFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: calculateBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates total buffer size based on partitions.

methods.name: getDataPtrForPartition
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to the data for a specific partition.

methods.name: getPlaybackTypePartition
methods.description: Returns the vector of partitions for a given playback type.
